title: ItsWolfNinja's 3D Name Tag
description: It's been 13 years since the Minecraft name tag has existed. During my research for the whackiest Minecraft 3D models not once do I recall seeing a 3D Minecraft name tag. This texture pack is a must have. It's simple yet effective.
body: Have you ever wondered if the Minecraft name tag could have more? Well if you have, this resource pack is for you. It adds 3D Name Tag. A 3D Name Tag that has not been 3D for 13 years of It's life. Thats alot of years.
